== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[Motti Seeker (PC Errata)]]. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member article. Columns are Original and PC Errata (Appendix A) only. Glossary 2.0 rewrote "present with" / "a pilot" / dropped "immediately" but there is no [[Motti Seeker (Errata)]] article, so that intermediate is not a column. The later D-E1 Holotable PNG is the same Appendix A wording (capitalizes Undercover) and is not a PC Errata 2 column. Do not add Revised, Japanese, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the Appendix A wording that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
